about: Held-out set v2, written 2026-11-03 BEFORE any calibration rule changes and frozen on commit. All names, numbers and domains are fictional or reserved (555 / 900xxx ranges, .example-style lookalikes). Labels follow the 3-verdict policy in docs/SCAM-DETECTION.md, not the rules' output. Do not tune rules or prompts on this set.

cases.text: Hi Patricia Walsh, you paid €8.40 EUR to The Coffee Dock. Transaction ID 3XK19284LM5567201. Thanks for using PayPal.
